verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://www.conductor.build/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured, agent-oriented index, and /docs.md returns clean markdown with frontmatter. The docs are also consistently served as .md pages (workflow.md, api.md, api/mcp.md, cloud.md, /markdown/pricing), so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus bundle, and no independent or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs.
